content_sections.heading: How Will UKSSSC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Physical Standard Test and Physical Efficiency Test (100 marks) Objective multiple-choice offline written competitive examination (100 marks) Merit list on PET marks (25% weightage) and written exam marks (75% weightage) Medical examination Stage 1: Physical Standard and Physical Efficiency Test under the Uttarakhand Uniformed Constable Posts Direct Recruitment Selection Procedure Rules-2025 as amended 2026 PET of 100 marks: cricket ball throw, long jump, chin-up (men), run/walk, shuttle race (women); Fireman also rope climbing Stage 2: 100-mark objective multiple-choice offline written competitive examination for successful candidates Merit list (final selection list): PET 25% weightage, written exam 75% weightage

content_sections.text: Apply online on the Commission's website www.sssc.uk.gov.in from 25-11-2026 to 25-12-2026. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 December 2026. Applications opened on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 1694 vacancies: 464 Uttarakhand Constable Civil Police (Male), 284 Uttarakhand Constable PAC/IRB (Male), 238 Uttarakhand Constable Civil Police (Female), 201 Fireman (Male/Female), 171 Forest Guard, 75 Special Tiger Guards and 5 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Uttarakhand Constable Civil Police (Male): 18 to 25 years; Uttarakhand Constable PAC/IRB (Male): 18 to 25 years; Uttarakhand Constable Civil Police (Female): 18 to 25 years; Fireman (Male/Female): 18 to 25 years; Forest Guard: 18 to 25 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs 21,700-Rs 69,100 (Level-03) for Uttarakhand Constable Civil Police (Male), Rs 21,700-Rs 69,100 (Level-03) for Uttarakhand Constable PAC/IRB (Male), Rs 21,700-Rs 69,100 (Level-03) for Uttarakhand Constable Civil Police (Female), Rs 21,700-Rs 69,100 (Level-03) for Fireman (Male/Female), Rs 21,700-Rs 69,100 (Level-03) for Forest Guard.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Intermediate examination pass or equivalent, from the board named for each post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Minimum physical standards of height and chest (men) prescribed post-wise, with lower limits for ST and hill-area candidates. Minimum body weight 45 kg for women candidates. Minimum marks required in every PET event; failing any event means disqualification. Vision not less than 6/6 in one eye and 6/9 in the other; free from colour blindness and squint.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not getting the minimum marks fixed for each PET event are declared disqualified.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Physical Standard Test and Physical Efficiency Test (100 marks). Objective multiple-choice offline written competitive examination (100 marks). Merit list on PET marks (25% weightage) and written exam marks (75% weightage). Medical examination.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Constable, Fireman, Secretariat Guard, Transport Constable: non-gazetted, permanent, contributory pension. Forest Guard and Special Tiger Guards: non-gazetted, temporary. Jail Guard and Female Jail Guard: non-gazetted / permanent / temporary / contributory pension.
